result.title: Centroid Spectral Coupling: Implicit Alignment and Representation Diversity in Self-Supervised Learning
result.summary: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) aims to align augmented views while preserving representation diversity and preventing collapse. Existing non-contrastive methods often address these goals using multiple weighted loss terms. We introduce Centroid Spectral Coupling (CSC), a single-term SSL objective that implicitly couples view alignment, representation diversity, and collapse resistance. CSC constructs centroids from independently normalized augmented-view pairs and applies a ridge-based spectral objective to their uncentered second-moment matrix. Preserving centroid magnitudes encodes view agreement while encouraging balanced representation energy across spectral directions. We establish an exact decomposition into nonnegative alignment and spectral-imbalance components, characterize the geometry of global optima, and derive finite-loss guarantees for alignment and diversity. We also show that complete constant-output collapse is a strict saddle in normalized representation space. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Imagenette show that CSC achieves the highest linear Top-1 accuracy among the evaluated non-contrastive methods on all three benchmarks, and the highest kNN Top-1 accuracy on both CIFAR datasets. A ridge-parameter sensitivity study reveals an empirical alignment--diversity trade-off: increasing $κ$ strengthens view alignment but reduces representation effective rank. These results show that a unified spectral objective yields competitive visual representations without explicit contrastive negatives or separately weighted alignment and diversity penalties.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Centroid Spectral Coupling（CSC），用基于质心未中心化二阶矩的单一 ridge 谱目标同时实现视图对齐、表示多样性与防坍缩，并给出精确分解、全局最优几何与有限损失下对齐/多样性保证，在 CIFAR-10/100 与 Imagenette 上取得有竞争力的线性探针与 kNN 精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接多模态推理关联，但其「对齐—多样性」单目标权衡、有效秩随参数下降的观察及常数输出坍缩为严格鞍点的分析，可供核查 LVR latent 状态训练中的信息坍缩与多样性监控是否可借用类似谱指标。
